ThingDef.label: crossroads tailored suit
ThingDef.description: An immaculate black three-piece suit with subtle crimson silk lining and silver cufflinks. Worn by dealmakers who prefer sealing contracts over brawling, its fabric is unnaturally resistant to scorching heat.

ThingDef.label: infernal operative coat
ThingDef.description: A heavy charcoal-black leather trenchcoat stitched with dark crimson thread along the lapels. Designed for long nights on the road, it turns aside blades and shrugs off flames.

ThingDef.label: seraphic rumpled trenchcoat
ThingDef.description: A weathered beige cotton trenchcoat worn over a dark suit and loose tie, tailored with reinforced vertical slits across the upper back to accommodate manifestation of celestial wings. Can only be worn by Angels.

ThingDef.label: celestial host vestment
ThingDef.description: Gleaming white-and-gold layered armor plates worn over a tailored tunic, open across the shoulder blades for angelic wings. Etched with Enochian script, it deflects demonic curses and cuts incoming demon and anomaly damage by 35%. Can only be worn by Angels.

ThingDef.label: brotherhood scribe fatigues
ThingDef.description: A practical crimson-and-tan canvas tunic fitted with leather tool pouches, brass buckles, and an embroidered gear-and-sword emblem on the shoulder.

ThingDef.label: T-60 Brotherhood power armor
ThingDef.description: Heavy steel-grey hydraulic power armor stamped with the Brotherhood of Steel crest on the chestplate. Worn on the dedicated Power Armor layer over regular clothing.

ThingDef.label: T-60 power armor helmet
ThingDef.description: An angular steel-grey armored helmet with a built-in tactical headlamp, rebreather filters, and armored glass visor.

ThingDef.label: Outcast recon bodysuit
ThingDef.description: A form-fitting dark charcoal and crimson ballistic undersuit fitted with reinforced elbow pads and power-armor interface ports.

ThingDef.label: Outcast T-45d power armor
ThingDef.description: Refurbished T-45d power armor painted matte black with stark blood-red trim and shoulder plates. Worn on the Power Armor layer over regular clothing.

ThingDef.label: Enclave officer uniform
ThingDef.description: A crisp black-and-slate double-breasted military uniform with silver shoulder boards and an eagle-and-stars insignia. Radiates cold authoritarian discipline.

ThingDef.label: Enclave X-01 power armor
ThingDef.description: Sleek, sloped composite power armor in jet-black finish with a towering neck guard. Worn on the Power Armor layer over regular clothing, its curved plates deflect high-velocity rounds and plasma blasts.

ThingDef.label: X-01 insectoid helmet
ThingDef.description: An intimidating black armored helmet shaped like a predatory insect head, featuring glowing amber optical lenses and dual filtration canisters.

ThingDef.label: Institute division lab coat
ThingDef.description: A pristine, sterile white synthetic coat with clean geometric seams and colored division stripes along the sleeves. Keeps its wearer comfortable in sterile subterranean labs.

ThingDef.label: Institute ceramic synth armor
ThingDef.description: Lightweight white ceramic-polymer plates strapped over a dark grey bodysuit. Mass-produced for synth strike teams, it offers crisp protection against energy weapons.

ThingDef.label: Institute Courser coat
ThingDef.description: A sleek, matte-black armored leather trenchcoat reinforced with woven carbon fibers and internal ceramic trauma plates. Worn by the Institute's deadliest synth retrievers.

ThingDef.label: ballistic-weave heavy coat
ThingDef.description: A patched, unassuming brown wasteland coat secretly lined with ultra-dense ballistic weave fibers. Looks like ordinary civilian clothing while stopping rifle rounds.

ThingDef.label: signal-tracker beanie & goggles
ThingDef.description: A knitted wool beanie wired with copper antennae and paired with tinted brass welding goggles. Built to spot stealth fields and block stray psychic noise.

ThingDef.label: Gunner reinforced combat armor
ThingDef.description: Olive-drab modular military armor plates strapped over dark green fatigues, stenciled with a white skull emblem on the shoulder guard. Built for professional wasteland mercenaries.

ThingDef.label: Gunner helmet with skull bandana
ThingDef.description: An olive-green army combat helmet paired with a lower-face bandana printed with a skeletal jaw. Protects against shrapnel and dusty wasteland winds.

ThingDef.label: Vault-Tec ribbed jumpsuit
ThingDef.description: A form-fitting cobalt-blue synthetic jumpsuit accented with bright yellow trim, brass zippers, and bold vault numerals across the back. Comfortable, durable, and iconic.

ThingDef.label: Vault security vest
ThingDef.description: A dark navy padded ballistic vest stenciled with 'SECURITY' in crisp white block letters, built to quell underground riots and hold airlock chokepoints.

ThingDef.label: weathered monster-hunter duster
ThingDef.description: A heavy, road-worn brown leather duster layered over a red-and-black flannel shirt, with hidden inner holsters and silver-stitched cuffs to fend off claws and fangs.

ThingDef.label: Minutemen colonial duster
ThingDef.description: A weathered navy-blue colonial frock coat reinforced with boiled leather shoulder plates, crossed bandoliers, and brass buttons. Inspires settlers to stand their ground.

ThingDef.label: Minutemen tricorn hat
ThingDef.description: A sturdy dark felt tricorn hat pinned with a brass musket-and-lightning badge. Shields the wearer from harsh sun and rain while projecting frontier authority.

ThingDef.label: Men of Letters warded suit
ThingDef.description: A bespoke British tweed three-piece suit interwoven with fine silver-alloy filaments and concealed Enochian wards sewn into the waistcoat.

ThingDef.label: London black-ops trenchcoat
ThingDef.description: A tailored navy-black waterproof trenchcoat fitted with concealed kevlar panels and brass ward-plates etched with binding sigils that reduce incoming supernatural damage by 25%.

ThingDef.label: crimson revolutionary coat
ThingDef.description: A faded, bullet-nicked crimson colonial frock coat worn over a battered waistcoat. Popularized by Goodneighbor's ghoul mayor, it commands respect among wasteland outcasts.

ThingDef.label: patched lead-lined poncho
ThingDef.description: A heavy wasteland poncho stitched from rubberized canvas, scrap leather, and thin lead foil strips. Built to endure toxic storms and acid rain.

ThingDef.label: super mutant scrap harness
ThingDef.description: Massive, crudely welded steel plates, rusted highway signs, and heavy iron chains bolted together to fit the hulking torso of a super mutant. Too huge for humans to wear.

ThingDef.label: super mutant rebar cage helmet
ThingDef.description: A brutal iron cage welded from thick rebar rods and bolted steel scrap, sized to protect a super mutant's massive skull in melee brawls. Can only be worn by Super Mutants.

ThingDef.label: nocturnal clan velvet coat
ThingDef.description: A long, high-collared midnight-black velvet and leather coat worn by ancient vampire elders. Tailored for silent movement and intimidating presence.

ThingDef.label: living bioferrite carapace
ThingDef.description: Organic crimson-black chitinous plates grown from hardened bioferrite and monster blood. Worn on the Power Armor layer over regular clothing, the living carapace accelerates wound healing by 25% and slowly repairs its own durability.
